race.comment: LAGOON (7) travelled in a rearwards position then picked up fairly well in the straight, making some late inroads to finish midfield. Steps up in distance today. Backmarker who keeps coming. Will prove hard to hold out. PROPER TWELVE (2) led pillar-to-post at Dubbo last start over this trip. Backs up quickly and is worth following up. DUSTY VERMEER (5) was sent out at $26 last time but ran above expectations and won over this trip at Narromine. Full of confidence now and can keep the ball rolling. WAY TO DIVINE (6) is yet to miss the placings from four starts over this track and trip. Is capable of running a bold race.
